children: British bank Revolut's website said some services had started working again by 1700 GMT on Tuesday, after an hours-long Google Cloud outage that disrupted several financial firms and public-sector websites.

Most Revolut services were still marked as having problems, including card payments, transfers, ATM withdrawals, currency exchange and stock trading. But six out of 27 services listed on the UK website, including support chat and internal transfers, were listed as working.
